title: Vanilla Afterglow
description: This is a vanilla like modpack with the best optimizations and stunning graphics!
body:
# Vanilla Afterglow

Vanilla Afterglow is a Vanilla+ modpack built around a simple idea: expand Minecraft without losing what makes it feel like Minecraft. Every mod has been carefully selected to enhance the core experience while preserving the familiar progression, creativity, and sense of adventure that players know and love.

Vanilla afterglow improves fps, adds shaders and some features that should be in vanilla!
The modpack has a fast startup time and doesnt require a good computer to run
Vanilla afterglow adds particles, dynamic lightning and hit effects on skeletons and some other mobs.
